name: Necromancer Reclaimed Life shortens Raise cast times by 15% (#1206)
contract: Reclaimed Life 707670 is a Class-tab node (CharacterAdvancement 31048, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab 87, AbilityEssenceCost 1, SpellFamilyName 29) whose description reads 'Reduces the cast time of your Raise spells by $s1%.' (its aura ToolTip about Sacrifice Undead is a leftover of another talent: the spell has no effect for it). Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) MiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), BasePoints -16 + DieSides 1 = -15, EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 0x2) in family 29: the Raise flag that AscensionNecromancer::Raised also tests, carried by Raise: Ghoul 500971 (1500 ms) and Raise: Skeletal Mage 500331 (2000 ms) but not by Ice Barrage 501992 (2000 ms, family flags 0, 0x40, 0). The aura is not 42/354, so the Necromancer load contract leaves it intact, and Unit::ModSpellCastTime applies the caster's SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME natively. Expected: with the talent Raise cast times are 85% of their base (1275 ms and 1700 ms) and Ice Barrage keeps its cast time; a real Raise: Ghoul cast starts with at most 1275 ms left instead of about 1500 ms, and still raises its Ghoul; unlearning restores the base cast time.
